summary: Executed backend pytest + frontend Playwright validation for PIC idea workflow, tab reordering, idea-to-RAB/KAK integration, and legacy tab accessibility.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout did not trigger 429 after 5 failed attempts in external preview traffic; test observed repeated 401 on 6th attempt.

issues: Console warning from Recharts: chart container width/height resolved to -1 intermittently (layout sizing issue).

action_items: Fix auth brute-force lock keying to avoid per-request proxy IP variance (use normalized client key, e.g., email-only + trusted forwarded IP parsing).
Add/adjust dashboard chart container sizing to remove Recharts negative width/height warnings.
Implement seed update logic for existing seeded admin/PIC/relawan passwords to satisfy auth playbook requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 1200 lines; split into focused modules (auth, projects, idea, AI, files, exports).
CORS is configured with allow_credentials=true while default allow_origins includes '*'; wildcard + credentials is unsafe/incompatible for cross-origin scenarios.
Seed logic currently inserts only when user missing; it does not update existing seeded accounts when password changes (playbook mismatch).
seed_data_creation: No manual seed insertion. UI testing created additional test projects via existing create-project flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is in /app/backend/tests/test_kegiatan_idea_workflow.py and already validates login cookies, /auth/me, idea chat/save/submit, progress chip backend signal, legacy endpoints, and bcrypt prefix. Frontend end-to-end flow succeeded on existing project path; includes Ide->RAB/KAK integration and tab order check.
rca of the issue: Likely root cause for lockout failure: login_attempts identifier uses request.client.host, but preview ingress may route requests via varying internal proxy IPs (observed multiple 10.208.x.x source hosts), so attempts do not accumulate under one identifier. Mitigation: derive stable identifier from normalized email + trusted forwarded client IP (or email-only with cooldown), and add explicit tests for proxy-forwarded environments.
